payload.text: Gradeability is decided against a NAMED minimum defect, named by DESCRIPTION and computed, never taken from an injection's own figure and never a multiplier. A floor is acceptable iff it sits below it. hv RULED THE VALUE 2026-09-09: a one-level shift over 5 percent of the frame. That is RMSE 0.223607, because showreel-harness rmse() sums squared differences over RGB and divides by 3*W*H, so a one-level shift over area fraction f is exactly sqrt(f) -- INDEPENDENT OF FRAME SIZE, so the magnitude transfers to any reel at any resolution rather than being a fact about 1920x1080. At 1920x1080 that is 103,680 pixels, about 429x241. Both UNDECIDED slides clear it: slide 13's floor 0.001500 is 149x below and slide 14's 0.002196 is 102x below, so naming this magnitude makes 21 of 22 gradeable and leaves only slide 1, which waits on AC-3.7. THE ROW CITED 6.29 UNTIL 2026-09-09 AND IT WAS NEVER THIS INJECTION'S VALUE. snorkeltoast re-measured at 0.999752; 6.29 needs an average shift of 6.29 levels, which a one-level darkening cannot produce on any capture, so the arithmetic rules it out without snorkeltoast's pace=ambient contamination hypothesis, which is now unnecessary rather than merely unproven. TWO FURTHER CLAIMS OF THIS ROW ARE WITHDRAWN, BOTH vc's. First, the 0.998249 to 2.280042 spread was NOT the injection varying by picture content: snorkeltoast ran the control the script never had -- re-encode with no injection -- and the pure injection spans 0.4 percent, not 2.3x. The range was a JPEG generation the harness introduced by decoding and re-encoding, and on slide 0, a PNG logo on black, 2.24 of the 2.28 is re-encode alone. Second, vc explained the readings above 1.0 as pixels moving more than one level where the darken clips. Clipping can only LOWER the figure, never raise it: vc verified that sqrt(1 - clipped_fraction) predicts every pure value to six decimals -- 0.718 percent clipped gives 0.996404, 0.003 percent gives 0.999984 -- so the pure injection is near-exact and its only deviation is the pixels that physically cannot darken. WHAT SURVIVES IS THE SQRT-AREA LEG, WHICH WAS ALWAYS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE AND IS NOW EXACT: a full-frame one-level defect measures 1.000000 and a four-pixel one measures 0.001389, a factor of 720, so any constant taken from an injection is blind to defects of smaller extent by exactly the ratio of their extents. AND A STATED LIMIT OF THE RED-PROOF, snorkeltoast's, flagged because this row's earlier wording implied otherwise: redproof darkens AND re-encodes at q86, so its reported figure is not a pure one-level injection. Both plausible targets on this reel are JPEG so today's result stands, but a reel of PNG sources would red-proof against a mostly-different defect. THIS IS WHY hv NAMED A DESCRIPTION AND THE NUMBER IS COMPUTED FROM IT. NOT YET SATISFIED: the magnitude is named and nobody has run the harness with --min-defect 0.223607, so the buckets are predicted and not measured.
